summary: Round 4 re-check of the Evaluación Oftalmológica reliable-save fixes. RESULT: FINAL PASS, nothing left open. (1) HIGH fix for the duplicate evaluation: the first POST /api/evaluaciones was forced to 500. The client tried 4 times (1 + 3 retries), the status became 'Guardado offline', and a 'create' entry was queued in localStorage (data.id = null, motivo 'DUP_TEST_1'). The route was then removed and 'DUP_TEST_2' typed. Autosave created the evaluation (status 'Guardado a las'), and the queue key novavision_evaluaciones_offline was removed right away (null). After waiting 37s there was still only ONE evaluation for the patient today, with motivo_consulta 'DUP_TEST_2'. The page sent no extra POST, and the queue was still empty. (2) LOW fix: the orange warning toast 'No se pudo conectar con el servidor' was visible after the failure (count 1) and gone after the next successful save (count 0). (3) Smoke test: a later edit went out as a PATCH to /autoguardar and the status turned green, and the floating indicator [data-testid=autoguardado-floating-indicator] stays visible after scrolling. (4) backend/tests/test_evaluacion_guardado_confiable.py: 9 passed, 2 skipped (same as before).

syncPendingData safeguard: the 'create' branch still needs evaluacionActual?.id to be set, which is correct (it only drops an entry once a server-confirmed evaluation exists).

Both were deleted by id afterwards: evaluation through the API; the patient through the API (soft delete), then hard-deleted by id in Mongo. No seed or user data was touched.
